listening.title: Talking about salary in the final interview round

lines.speaker: Thu (HR Manager)
lines.text: Khoa, we are happy with your interview. May I ask about your expected salary?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: Thank you. Could you first share the salary range for this position?

lines.speaker: Thu (HR Manager)
lines.text: The range is twenty to twenty-eight million VND, depending on experience.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: I see. Is that number the gross salary before tax and insurance?

lines.speaker: Thu (HR Manager)
lines.text: Yes, it is. Your take-home pay will be lower after tax and social insurance.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: Understood. A ballpark figure for me would be around twenty-six million gross.

lines.speaker: Thu (HR Manager)
lines.text: That is possible. Please note the probation salary is eighty-five percent for two months.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: That is fine. Does the company also pay a performance bonus during the year?

lines.speaker: Thu (HR Manager)
lines.text: Yes, twice a year, and we can discuss a small sign-on bonus for you.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: That sounds fair. Could you send the details in writing so I can review them?
